tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a short link that redirects to a URL. Returns shortUrl, which is what you share.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the active (not expired) links of the account with their click counts and tags. Optionally only the links that carry any of the given tags.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Details of one link: destination, destination rules (reglas) if any, clicks by people, bots apart (link previews and crawlers, not counted in clicks), creation and expiry dates, last click and recent click history. For countries, devices and referrers use get_analytics with the same code.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change where a link points, set a new expiry (Pro) or remove its expiry, or set destination rules (Pro): rotate clicks among several URLs (e.g. a WhatsApp rotator between salespeople) or send by country or device. Also (Pro) an activation date, a click limit, and what visitors see when the link is n

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a link permanently. Anyone opening it afterwards gets "not found". Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Click analytics by people (bots reported apart): totals, daily series, countries, devices, browsers, referrers and top links. On Pro (and the trial) also aiTraffic (visits from AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Perplexity, with their share and breakdown), cities (top 10 with their country) and QR sca

tools.name: compare_tags
tools.description: Compare the links that carry some tags (e.g. one QR per table, shop window or flyer): for each link, people, QR scans, bots apart and its top countries and devices, over the same period so the rows add up to the total. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_links" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the active (not expired) links of the account with their click counts." → after: "List the active (not expired) links of the account with their click counts and tags. Optionally only the links that carry any of the given tags."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
